newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - AmeriCredit, Aames started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - AmeriCredit, Aames started.

text.p: -- Prudential Securities confirmed it initiated coverage of AmeriCredit Corp and Aames Financial Corp with buy ratings.
-- Analyst Michael Durante said AmeriCredit is an exceptionally strong lender that should garner significant market share in an industry shake-out.
-- estimates earnings for June 1997 year at $1.25 a share, compared to $0.71 in previous year.
-- estimates June 1998 year earnings at $1.65 a share.
-- Prudential said analyst Jennifer Scutti initiated coverage of Aames Financial with a buy rating.
-- further details on Aames were not available.
